resources.string: Choose who can reach you, and when. Everyone else rings as usual.
Filtering is temporarily paused while your changes are saved.
Weekly scheduling is off. The independent timer can still block enabled numbers.
Enabled numbers are allowed during your windows and filtered outside them.
Complete setup below. All calls are allowed while a required permission is missing.

Android needs to choose unconnected as its call screening app. Contacts permission lets Android include saved callers; the app reads only the name and phone numbers of the contact you explicitly choose.
Call screening is unavailable on this device.
If Android no longer asks, enable Contacts in app settings. Without both permissions, filtering stays paused.
Only enabled numbers in this list follow the schedule and temporary timer.
Your list is empty. Add a number to start; no calls are filtered yet.
For national numbers, choose their country (IT, GB, US…). International numbers begin with + and a country code.
Enter a valid complete phone number or numeric range and a supported two-letter region. Extensions and short codes are not supported.
This number is already in your list.
This number will ring normally after it is removed.
One weekly schedule for all enabled numbers. Times follow the current device time zone: %1$s.
No allowed hours. An active, confirmed schedule filters enabled numbers all week; the timer works independently.
Choose at least one day and different start and end times.
Start is included; end is excluded. An end time earlier than the start continues into the next day.
Without allowed hours, every enabled number will be filtered whenever scheduling is active. Other callers are still allowed.
Calls from enabled numbers will only be allowed in the remaining windows.

Forwarded calls may show the original caller, not the switchboard number. Only the number Android presents can be matched. Hidden, ambiguous and unlisted callers are always allowed.

Quiet blocking and notification suppression depend on Android and your phone manufacturer. Android may keep blocked calls in its call log. Test with someone you trust before relying on filtering.

Your settings stay on this phone. No account, Internet, analytics or call recording. Deactivate at any time or uninstall normally.
Could not save changes. Filtering is paused for this app session. Previously saved settings may return after restart. Retry saving or remove the screening role in system settings.
Saved settings could not be read safely. All calls are allowed. Reset only if you want to discard these settings and start again.
This removes your saved numbers, hours and timer. Both controls start off.
Android could not open this setting.
A settings update paused filtering. Save a change or deactivate to recover. Previously saved settings may return after the app restarts.
Choose a contact, then one of its distinct numbers if needed. Review or edit the fields and tap Save to confirm.
Reading numbers for the selected contact…
Could not read this contact. Try again or enter the number manually.
The contacts picker is unavailable or access was denied. You can still enter the number manually.
Contacts permission is needed to read the chosen contact. Use Allow Contacts on the main screen, or enter the number manually.
This contact has no phone numbers. Choose another contact or enter a number manually.
These numbers cannot be read unambiguously for the selected country. Check the country and try again, or enter the full international number manually.
This contact has too many phone entries to display safely. Enter the required number manually.
Equivalent formats appear once. Choose one number to fill the editor; nothing is saved until you tap Save.
Some entries could not be read unambiguously for the selected country. Only verified numbers are shown. Cancel to check the country or enter another number manually.
Enter a full number, or replace its final digits with * to filter a range (e.g. 02 12345***).
This mask covers %1$s possible numbers. Save it anyway?
Temporarily block enabled numbers and ranges, even during allowed hours or while scheduling is off. Other callers ring as usual.
Enter up to six digits in hours, minutes, seconds order (HHMMSS). Maximum 99:59:59.
Choose at least 1 second, with minutes and seconds between 00 and 59.
Complete phone setup on the home screen before starting a timer.
When the timer ends or is stopped, your current schedule takes effect immediately.
Start temporary blocking independently of your weekly schedule.
All enabled numbers are blocked until the timer ends, including during allowed hours.
Timer stopped or finished. Your current schedule applies.
A reliable timer clock is unavailable. No timer was started. Your schedule is unchanged.
The weekly schedule is invalid or unconfirmed and cannot filter calls. Remove or repair invalid windows. The independent timer can still be used.
